title: Rust: port dispatch for 568x and 10883
close_reason: Verified existing Rust UDP port dispatch implementation covers Compact CoT 5681, SenML 5682, CoAP 5683, reserved 5684 rejection, Cayenne 5685, APRS-IS 5686, NMEA 5687, MQTT-SN 10883, unknown ports, SCHC range detection, and Node IPv6/UDP destination-port integration. Focused tests, package fmt, and clippy pass.
